newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Jail terms for conspirators in Rabin murder.
newsitem.headline: Jail terms for conspirators in Rabin murder.

text.p: A Tel Aviv court on Thursday sentenced Yitzhak Rabin's assassin Yigal Amir, his brother and a third religious Jew to prison terms ranging from five to 12 years for plotting the late prime minister's murder.

Yigal Amir, 26, is already serving a life sentence for killing Rabin at a Tel Aviv peace rally last November to try to halt Middle East peace moves. The three were convicted on all charges last month in a separate conspiracy trial.
The court sentenced Yigal Amir to an additional five years in prison, Hagai Amir to 12 years, and Dror Adani to seven years.

The three were convicted of plotting Rabin's murder -- including plans to rig his car with explosives and poisen him -- and planning attacks against Palestinians. Hagai Amir was also convicted of various weapons charges.
"We must always remember this incident and never forget it," said presiding Judge Amnon Strashnov in delivering the sentence.
Yigal Amir said in court he was proud of killing Rabin and was only sorry he had not done it years earlier, before Israel handed over parts of the West Bank and Gaza for Palestinian self-rule.
